channel_conventions.deck_rows: deck rows carry ch=1; the unit sends on deck channel 1-4 (status 9n/Bn, n=deck-1). Left side = deck 1/3, right side = deck 2/4.
channel_conventions.channel_assignment: ch1 browser (shared with deck 1), ch1-4 decks, ch5 effect+mixer, ch6-9 pads, ch12 LOAD LED / jog display (MIDI OUT only)

controls.name: jog_platter_rotate
controls.notes: JOG dial (platter) rotate, relative: cw from 0x41, ccw from 0x3F; deck ch 1-4 (left side deck 1/3, right side deck 2/4) [1-1]

controls.name: jog_touch
controls.notes: JOG dial (platter) touch; deck ch 1-4 (left side deck 1/3, right side deck 2/4) [1-1]

controls.name: tempo_msb
controls.notes: TEMPO slider MSB (14-bit 0-16383, - side 0, + side 16383; LSB CC 32) [1-2]

controls.name: vinyl_speed_adjust
controls.notes: VINYL SPEED ADJUST button (hardware button), plate label 1-8-1 [1-8]

controls.name: vinyl_speed_adjust_volume
controls.notes: VINYL SPEED ADJUST volume (SHORT CUT), plate row 8-2; sent only while VINYL SPEED ADJUST is ON; five levels 0x00/0x12/0x3F/0x6D/0x7F [1-8]

controls.name: load
controls.notes: LOAD (hardware button), sent on the target deck's channel 1-4 [1-22]

controls.name: needle_touch
controls.notes: NEEDLE (GUI, overall waveform position display) touch [1-23]
